response: Yes, synergy exists between lysosomotropic amines and cyclosporine in the suppression of T-cell responses to minor and major histocompatibility antigens. The combination of these two substances appears to be synergistic in suppressing T-cell proliferation to both MiHC and MHC. This synergy may have implications for the control of graft-versus-host disease (GVHD), as the use of chloroquine in combination with cyclosporine may result in improved control of GVHD.
